text.text: Run the shop from one page. Clients, services and payments are linked, every cut is a row with a barber, and walk-ins go on the board as they arrive. Each barber sees their own chair under Mine.

Walk-ins are the lifeblood. Keep the queue honest and the wait short.
Greet and write the name on the Cuts board with a rough wait time.
Keep a barber for walk-ins at the busiest hours.
Text people when they are next if they step out.
Fridays after 3 and Saturdays before noon. Stop taking new walk-ins when the wait exceeds 90 minutes and offer an appointment.
Know what each barber owes and earns before the week ends.
